description: This is a code-behind file for the UserProfile page of an online examination system. It manages user profile data retrieval from a SQL Server database, session validation, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind for the UserProfile page handling user data display and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; retrieves user info based on session and populates form fields.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Currently commented out; intended to reload user profile.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the taken courses page.
